videos.author: Crowfriend Games
videos.title: Blender to Godot from Scratch
videos.description:
Check the chapter marks to skip around.

This video shows the entire process of modeling a frog in Blender from scratch, rigging, animating, and bringing it into Godot with an animation tree. The entire process is shown in real time and takes about two hours — AND YOU CAN TOO!

I COULD REALLY USE YOUR SUPPORT! Wishlist my game The Mailroom - an upcoming horror job simulator where you work in the mailroom of a regional office of Hell in Modesto, California.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3965430/The_Mailroom/

videos.title: Modeling a frog character - Blender Tutorial
videos.description:
In this tutorial, we'll learn how to model and render a frog character.

The reference image used in this tutorial can be found here.

https://pixabay.com/illustrations/character-smile-icons-adorable-5172030

Please use the following tutorial to copy my Blender settings for Open Image Denoise, Filmic, Curves, transparent background and so on.
